+---
+## What
+
+The chat side no longer chooses an executor, so remove the machinery that
+chose one. Claude becomes hardcoded. The haiku-versus-default choice stays,
+but as a plain configuration field, not a model-name lookup.
+
+- Delete the llama-executor model YAMLs from `builtin/models/`: `qwen.yaml`,
+  `qwen-0.6b-test.yaml`, `qwen-0.8b-mtp-test.yaml`, `GLM.yaml`,
+  `MiniMax-2.5.yaml`.
+- KEEP the embedding model YAMLs `nomic-embed-code.yaml` and
+  `qwen-embedding.yaml`. The embedding stack still resolves them through
+  `ModelManager`, so the loader must keep working for those.
+- Remove the executor field and the executor enum from the chat model
+  configuration in `crates/swissarmyhammer-config/src/model.rs`. Claude is the
+  only chat executor.
+- Replace the review model-name resolution: `resolve_review_agent_name`
+  currently maps the review scope to `claude-code-haiku` by name. Turn that
+  into a boolean-or-enum configuration field that picks the Claude CLI model
+  switch directly, so `claude-code.yaml` and `claude-code-haiku.yaml` are no
+  longer needed to express the choice.
+- Remove `extract_model_flag` and the `--model` global flag from
+  `apps/swissarmyhammer-cli/src/main.rs` (line 290) and the
+  `model_override` parameter it feeds into `initialize_tool_context`
+  (line 310), unless the new configuration field needs a flag — in which case
+  rename it to match.
+
+Find the remaining sites with
+`grep -rn "resolve_review_agent_name\|claude-code-haiku\|executor" crates/swissarmyhammer-config/ crates/swissarmyhammer-agent/ apps/swissarmyhammer-cli/`.
+
+### Subtasks
+
+- [ ] Delete the five llama-executor model YAMLs.
+- [ ] Remove the executor field and enum from the chat model configuration.
+- [ ] Replace review model-name resolution with a configuration field.
+- [ ] Resolve the `--model` flag: remove it, or rename it to the new field.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `builtin/models/` holds only `claude-code.yaml`,
+      `claude-code-haiku.yaml`, `nomic-embed-code.yaml`, and
+      `qwen-embedding.yaml` — or only the two embedding YAMLs if the Claude
+      configs also become unnecessary.
+- [ ] The chat model configuration type has no executor field.
+- [ ] Review still runs against the Claude haiku model, chosen through the new
+      configuration field, and `sah doctor` reports the same model it runs.
+- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` exits 0 with
+      zero warnings.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] Add a unit test in `crates/swissarmyhammer-config/` that loads the
+      builtin models and asserts the two embedding YAMLs still resolve through
+      `ModelManager` — this proves the collapse did not break the embedding
+      path.
+- [ ] Update or replace the existing review model-resolution test so it
+      asserts the review scope resolves to the Claude haiku switch through the
+      new configuration field. Find it with
+      `grep -rn "resolve_review_agent_name" --include=*.rs crates/`.
+- [ ] Run `cargo nextest run --workspace` — the whole suite passes.
+
+## Workflow
+
+- Use `/tdd` — write the embedding-still-resolves test and the review-model
+  test first.
+#llama-agent #config #cleanup

+    Three parallel sweeps over the whole tree. Findings that change the plan:

So the enum cannot simply be deleted — the chat variants come out, the embedding variants stay, and `embedder.rs` needs a small mechanical follow-up (its `other =>` arm becomes an unreachable pattern, and `EmbedderError::NotAnEmbeddingModel` becomes dead).
+
+    **`sah doctor` reports no model at all.** No check in `crates/swissarmyhammer-doctor/` or `apps/swissarmyhammer-cli/src/commands/doctor/` mentions a model. The only record of the resolved review tier is `tracing::info!("review scope → …")` in serve and `"Building claude agent (executor=…, extra_args=…)"` in the agent. So there is no doctor/runtime disagreement to reintroduce; the single resolver keeps that property.
+
+    **`ModelConfig::claude_code_haiku()` is already dead** — doc comments only.
+
+    **`use_agent` / `use_agent_for` / `ModelTarget` have zero production callers.** They wrote the model NAME into config for the deleted `sah model` command. Under a Claude-switch field they are actively wrong (`validate_agent` → `find_agent_by_name` would only ever find embedding models), so they go.
+
+    **`--model` has TWO divergent definitions**: the clap derive `apps/swissarmyhammer-cli/src/cli.rs` (used only to generate docs/completions) and the hand-built `Arg` in `apps/swissarmyhammer-cli/src/dynamic_cli.rs` (what the binary actually parses), with different help text. `extract_model_flag` hand-scans argv (no `--model=x`, scans past `--`) because the tool context is built before the CLI is parsed. Zero tests. Removing it is the clean resolution.
+

+    - `crates/swissarmyhammer-config/src/template_context.rs` — `get_agent_config` / `get_all_agent_configs` are the template-context half of the chat model YAML system, plus a compiled doctest using `LlamaAgentConfig`.
+    - `crates/swissarmyhammer-config/src/lib.rs` — a public `test_config` module and ~15 llama-only DEFAULT_* constants.
+    - `crates/swissarmyhammer-config/tests/integration/` — `llama_config.rs`, `agent_config_file_loadings.rs`, `agent_hierarchical_configs.rs`, plus parts of `model_configs.rs` and `builtin_agents_generation.rs`.
+    - `crates/swissarmyhammer-kanban/src/board/update.rs` — `validate_model_id` accepts `ClaudeCode | LlamaAgent`; 7 inline tests and `tests/per_board_model_isolation.rs` use `qwen` as their example chat model.
+    - `crates/swissarmyhammer-tools` — `model_override` threads through `McpServer::new_with_work_dir`, `start_mcp_server`, `start_mcp_server_with_options`, `start_stdio_server`, `start_http_server`, `initialize_mcp_server`; ~30 call sites, most passing `None`.
+    - `apps/kanban-app/src/state.rs` — one `start_mcp_server_with_options` call site.
+    - `scripts/review-verify/drive.py` — runs `sah serve --model qwen`.
+    - `ARCHITECTURE.md` and `doc/src/concepts/validators.md`.
+
+    ### Design
+
+    - New `ChatModelConfig { model: Option<String> }` in `swissarmyhammer-config`. No executor field. `model` IS the Claude CLI `--model` switch; `None` spawns plain `claude`.
+    - `REVIEW_DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL = "haiku"` replaces `REVIEW_DEFAULT_AGENT = "claude-code-haiku"`.
+    - Precedence is unchanged, only the value's meaning changes: `review.model` → top-level `model:` → `haiku`.
+    - `ModelConfig` / `ModelExecutorConfig` / `ModelExecutorType` become embedding-only.
+    - `builtin/models/` keeps only the two embedding YAMLs; `claude-code.yaml` and `claude-code-haiku.yaml` go too, because the switch is now a config field.
+    - `--model`, `extract_model_flag` and `model_override` are removed end to end.

+  text: |
+    ### Implementation landed
+
+    Followed the approved design. 81 files, +1397 / -6153.
+
+    **The new chat configuration.** `ChatModelConfig { model: Option<String> }` in `crates/swissarmyhammer-config/src/model.rs`. No executor field. `model` IS the Claude CLI `--model` switch; `None` spawns plain `claude`. `claude_args()` is the single source of truth for the switch lookup, so the value a tool reports and the value the spawned process receives cannot drift. `REVIEW_DEFAULT_CLAUDE_MODEL = "haiku"` replaces `REVIEW_DEFAULT_AGENT = "claude-code-haiku"`.
+
+    Precedence is unchanged; only the meaning of the value changed. `review.model` → top-level `model:` → `haiku`, applied by the pure `ModelManager::review_chat_model_from`. Resolvers: `resolve_chat_config`, `resolve_review_chat_config`, `resolve_review_chat_model`, plus `get_chat_model` / `get_review_chat_model` over a shared `read_model_key`, so both scopes read the file the same way and cannot disagree about a missing file, an absent key, or a non-string value.
+
+    **The equivalent clear error.** With Claude hardcoded there is no unsupported executor to name, so `executor_config_name` had nothing left to report. The one way a chat configuration can still be wrong is a blank switch, which would spawn `claude --model ""` and fail deep inside the Claude CLI. That is now rejected in two places with a message that names the setting to fix: `chat_config_from_switch` at config-read time (naming `model` or `review.model`) and `create_agent_with_options` at the agent seam.
+
+    **Embedding.** `ModelConfig` / `ModelExecutorConfig` / `ModelExecutorType` are now embedding-only. `crates/swissarmyhammer-embedding/src/embedder.rs` got the mechanical follow-up: its `other =>` arm became an unreachable pattern and `EmbedderError::NotAnEmbeddingModel` went dead, so both are gone along with the two tests that asserted a chat model is rejected. Nothing else in the embedding stack was touched — `git diff HEAD --stat` shows zero changes under `llama-common`, `llama-embedding`, `model-loader`, `ane-embedding`, `model-embedding`.
+
+    **`--model` removed end to end.** `extract_model_flag`, both divergent flag definitions (`cli.rs` derive and `dynamic_cli.rs` `Arg`), and the `model_override` parameter through `initialize_tool_context` → `CliToolContext::new_with_config` (renamed `new_with_work_dir`) → `McpServer::new_with_work_dir` → `start_mcp_server` / `start_mcp_server_with_options` / `start_stdio_server` / `start_http_server` / `initialize_mcp_server`, about 30 call sites. `completions/*` and `doc/src/reference/sah-cli.md` were REGENERATED via `apps/swissarmyhammer-cli/build.rs`, not hand-edited.
+
+    ### Decisions worth recording
+
+    - **`builtin/models/` keeps only the two embedding YAMLs.** `claude-code.yaml` and `claude-code-haiku.yaml` went too — with the switch a configuration field, they no longer express anything. This is the second branch the acceptance criteria allow.
+    - **The board's `model` field is now a Claude CLI switch.** `validate_model_id` in `crates/swissarmyhammer-kanban/src/board/update.rs` can no longer enumerate valid values (the Claude CLI owns that vocabulary, including full model ids), so it rejects a blank id and rejects any id that names a model in the library — every model YAML there is an embedding model, which cannot drive a chat agent. `test_update_board_rejects_unknown_model` became `test_update_board_rejects_blank_model`; the embedding-rejection test survives unchanged.
+    - **`TemplateContext::get_agent_config` / `get_all_agent_configs` deleted.** They were the template-context half of the chat model YAML system (`agent.default`, `agent.configs.<workflow>`), with one production caller — a fallback in `server.rs` that now yields `ChatModelConfig::default()`. Their two integration test files went with them.
+    - **`use_agent` / `use_agent_for` / `ModelTarget` deleted**, with `validate_agent`, `validate_agent_name_security`, `load_or_create_config`, `save_config`, `update_config_with_agent`, `check_file_readable`. They wrote a model NAME for the deleted `sah model` command and were actively wrong under a switch field: `validate_agent` → `find_agent_by_name` would only ever find embedding models.
+    - **`ModelInfo.tags` / `parse_model_tags` deleted.** Nothing read the field; its own doc comment said it existed so the (deleted) kanban AI panel could filter chat models.
+    - **`ChatModelConfig` carries no serde derives.** Verified by removing them and rebuilding the workspace: zero errors. The switch is read as a plain string from the config file, never deserialized as a struct — which is exactly the "configuration field, not a model-name lookup" the card asked for.
+
+    ### What did not work
+
+    The first sweep of the `model_override` call sites used a generic "drop the Nth argument" script over every file naming `start_mcp_server*`. It matched the function DEFINITIONS in `unified_server.rs` too and silently deleted their `working_dir` parameter. Caught by the next build. If someone repeats this, exclude the defining file or anchor the match on the call syntax.
+
+    ### Discovered, filed separately
+
+    `apps/kanban-cli/.skills/kanban/SKILL.md` still says "across both Claude Code and llama-agent sessions". Its source `builtin/skills/kanban/SKILL.md` is already correct — only the deployed copy is stale, and `.skills/` is generated, so the fix is a regeneration rather than a hand edit. Pre-existing drift from commit 5edda8286, filed as `^qg2h0ta`.
+
+    ### Verification
+
+    - `cargo fmt --all` — clean.
+    - `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` — exits 0, zero warnings.
+    - `cargo nextest run --workspace` — 13337 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
+    - `builtin/models/` holds exactly `nomic-embed-code.yaml` and `qwen-embedding.yaml`.
+    - Real-path embedding proof: `swissarmyhammer-kanban::search_tasks_e2e qwen_embedding_search_tasks_real_pipeline_e2e` PASSES — that drives `qwen-embedding` through `ModelManager` → `Embedder` → a real search, so the invariant this whole project was meant to preserve is proved by the production path, not by a fixture.
